data: Which of these are weight matrix block divisions used in the figure?

The figure shows two lines representing the reweighted training accuracy for two different weight matrix block divisions on the CoLA dataset with the DistilBERT model. The lines are labeled as "8 blocks" and "128 blocks," which correspond to the two weight matrix block divisions mentioned in the question. Therefore, the weight matrix block divisions used in the figure are 8 blocks and 128 blocks.
